title: Nave Mainnet Cutover Env Schema
description: Env schema for mainnet cutover. Default scope is bridge-stake (required). Full DAO cutover also needs requiredFull.

JUPITER_LENDING_PROGRAM_ID.description: Signer/edge: Jupiter Lend lending program ID. Same as VITE_ variant.

JUPITER_LIQUIDITY_PROGRAM_ID.description: Signer/edge: Jupiter Lend liquidity program ID. Same as VITE_ variant.

VITE_MARGINFI_PROGRAM_ID.description: MarginFi v2 lending program (configure_marginfi_position / marginfi_deposit / marginfi_withdraw). Mainnet: MFv2hWf31Z9kbCa1snEPYctwafyhdvnV7FZnsebVacA

MARGINFI_PROGRAM_ID.description: Signer: MarginFi v2 lending program ID. Same as VITE_ variant.

JUPITER_API_KEY.description: Jupiter API key for Earn account resolution + live yield rates. Required by signer and edge functions.

JITO_TIP_LAMPORTS.description: SOL tip per Jito bundle in lamports (default 5000 ≈ $0.001 at $200/SOL). Higher = faster landing. Set to 10000-50000 for large treasury moves.

JITO_BUNDLE_REBALANCE_ENABLED.description: Enable atomic Jito bundle rebalancing via Helius (default true on mainnet). Set false to disable globally.

NAVE_AGENT_MODEL.description: Dispatcher model id (fine-tuned A/B seam). Defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6 when unset. Changing the model NEVER bypasses the deterministic guardrails.

NAVE_GUARDRAILS_FAIL_CLOSED.description: Dispatcher fail-closed override. Unset (default) and "true" both fail closed. MUST NEVER be "false" on mainnet — cutover refuses if set to "false".

NAVE_AUTOPROPOSE_ENABLED.description: Master autonomy gate for proposal-creator. Default false (observe-only). When true, the planner creates on-chain Strategy proposals.

NAVE_AUTOPROPOSE_WITHDRAW_ENABLED.description: Extra opt-in gate for proposing withdraw legs, layered on NAVE_AUTOPROPOSE_ENABLED. Default false. Requires NAVE_AUTOPROPOSE_ENABLED=true to take effect.

NAVE_COMPOUND_ENABLED.description: Orchestrator yield-aware harvest->redeploy compounding. Default false. Explicit opt-in.

NAVE_COMPOUND_MIN_GAIN_BPS.description: Minimum realized gain (in bps of deposited principal) before a harvest is worthwhile. Default 100 (1%).

NAVE_SWAP_ENABLED.description: Signer agent swap capability (jupiter_swap action — off-chain Jupiter swap/aggregator route + signer submit; distinct from Jupiter Lend). FAIL-CLOSED: disabled unless "true". The DAO creation/bootstrap flow does NOT depend on it (bootstrap first action is SOL->Jito). Default false.

NAVE_SWAP_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS.description: Cap on the per-swap slippage bound an agent may request for jupiter_swap (basis points). Default 1000 (10%). Only relevant when NAVE_SWAP_ENABLED=true.

NAVE_PROTOCOL_REVENUE_WALLET.description: Server-side mirror of the protocol revenue wallet (15% realized-yield skim destination). Defaults to VITE_NAVE_PROTOCOL_FEE_WALLET when unset. Must be a real funded mainnet wallet. There is no annual management fee.

NAVE_PERFORMANCE_FEE_BPS.description: Performance fee in bps (15% of realized yield, skimmed on strategy withdrawal). Must be 1500. Cutover refuses any other value. On-chain FeeConfig is authoritative; this is for preflight surfacing.

NAVE_MANAGEMENT_FEE_BPS.description: Annual management fee in bps. Must be 0. Cutover refuses any other value. The signer does not collect a management fee.

FORMATION_FEE_LAMPORTS.description: OPTIONAL Solana formation fee in lamports (written to global_config.formation_fee_lamports). Canonical value is 0: initialize_dao charges no protocol fee (gas and rent only). When set, the cutover REFUSES any value other than 0.

TREASURY_SEED_LAMPORTS.description: OPTIONAL Solana treasury-seed constant in lamports (mirrors nave_core::TREASURY_SEED_LAMPORTS). Canonical value is 0 on all networks — user seed is supplied separately in the creation wizard. When set, the cutover REFUSES any value other than 0.

MAINNET_NAVE_MINT.description: OPTIONAL re-confirmation of the canonical mainnet NAVE SPL mint (EGg56E1YtL5YapzkF7vkRThHR8i5FeRvm2LLuySdYory). New treasuries do not lock NAVE. When set it MUST equal the canonical mint; the devnet replica mint (GmBMZuXsXpe7TZK27PTcXUyNGcuw9Ew8v3fxys7wM9Wa) is REFUSED anywhere on the mainnet path.

NAVE_STAKE_TOKEN.description: OPTIONAL wrapped-NAVE ERC-20 address recorded by NaveProtocol.setNaveStakeConfig. New treasuries lock nothing. The stake phase may still set the moonlight module so an existing lock can be released. REQUIRED_NAVE_STAKE must be 0.

REQUIRED_NAVE_STAKE.description: Required wrapped-NAVE amount for NaveProtocol.setNaveStakeConfig, in token base units. Must be 0 or unset. Forming a treasury does not require NAVE. A non-zero value fails the cutover.

DAO_STAKE_MODULE.description: OPTIONAL NaveDaoStake escrow/moonlight module address wired via NaveProtocol.setDaoStake. Kept so an existing locked stake can be released. New treasuries do not lock NAVE, and reopening does not require a new stake.

NAVE_AGENT_SOL_REQUEST_THRESHOLD.description: Critically-low REQUEST tier in SOL (default 0.05). Below this an agent is flagged URGENT and refilled.

NAVE_AGENT_SOL_OPERATE_LEVEL.description: Operate tier in SOL (default 0.10). At/above this an agent can operate and makes no requests.

NAVE_AGENT_SOL_FILL_CEILING.description: Refill target in SOL (default 0.25). Wallets are topped up to this; never above.

NAVE_AGENT_SOL_REFILL_TRIGGER.description: Refill trigger in SOL (default 0.10). Refill toward the ceiling only when balance ≤ this (hysteresis).

MANAGEMENT_FEE_INTERVAL_MS.description: Unused. The signer no longer runs a management-fee collector. Leave unset. A stale value is ignored and is not required for cutover.

NAVE_OPS_WALLET_SECRET.description: Protocol operations keypair (base64 or comma-separated bytes) used by the worker for agent-wallet replenishment. Funded from the 15% yield skim. It is not a management-fee collector.

NAVE_CLUSTER.description: Signer/edge cluster selector. Allowed values: mainnet | mainnet-beta | devnet | localnet. MUST be "mainnet" on the mainnet cutover path — it drives the on-chain Jupiter program-id assertion and the signer rate-limiter fail-closed posture. Cutover REFUSES if it is not "mainnet".

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.description: Upstash Redis REST URL backing the signer rate-limiter + circuit breaker. REQUIRED on mainnet: the signer FAILS CLOSED (refuses to sign) when Redis is unreachable.

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN.description: Upstash Redis REST token for the signer rate-limiter + circuit breaker. REQUIRED on mainnet (signer fails closed without it).

NAVE_SIGNER_SKIP_SIMULATION.description: Signer pre-broadcast transaction-simulation bypass. MUST NOT be "true" on mainnet — simulation is the final fail-closed guard before broadcasting a signed tx. Cutover REFUSES if set to "true".

NAVE_SIGNER_RATE_PER_ACTION.description: Per-action signer rate limit (default 20). Positive integer.

NAVE_SIGNER_RATE_PER_ROLE.description: Per-role signer rate limit (default 20). Positive integer.

NAVE_SIGNER_RATE_GLOBAL.description: Global signer rate limit (default 300). Positive integer.

NAVE_SIGNER_CB_THRESHOLD.description: Circuit-breaker consecutive-failure threshold before tripping (default 5). Positive integer.

NAVE_SIGNER_CB_WINDOW_MS.description: Circuit-breaker failure-counting window in ms (default 60000). Positive integer.

NAVE_SIGNER_CB_COOLDOWN_MS.description: Circuit-breaker cooldown before half-open in ms (default 120000). Positive integer.

NAVE_MAX_NAV_AGE_SECONDS.description: App-side NAV freshness window (seconds) gating strategy deploys. Must be a positive integer that does NOT exceed the on-chain NAV_MAX_STALENESS_SECS=900 (recommend 900 to match). Strategy deploys hard-block on stale NAV; revalue_treasury must be fresh (<15 min) before execute.

NAVE_VAULT_LAST_REVALUED_OFF.description: Byte offset of treasury_vault.last_revalued_at within the TreasuryVault account, used to read on-chain NAV age. For the current TreasuryVault layout this is 130 (account LEN 138); the cutover preflight REFUSES if it is unset, non-integer, or not equal to the expected offset. Required (non-negative integer) on mainnet so the offset is never silently 0.

NAVE_REVALUE_TREASURY_KEEPER_CONFIRMED.description: Mainnet release acknowledgement that revalue_treasury keeper coverage is deployed and monitored. Required because strategy execution hard-blocks on stale NAV.

VITE_EVM_NETWORK.description: EVM environment selector. OPTIONAL (EVM is additive to Solana). When EVM is enabled (this set, or any VITE_EVM_*_FACTORY_ADDRESS present), the cutover REQUIRES this to be "mainnet". Scope is Ethereum + Base only.

VITE_EVM_CHAIN_ID.description: Optional explicit active EVM chain id. Must be one of 1 (Ethereum) or 8453 (Base) on the mainnet path. Any other id (e.g. BSC 56) is HARD-REJECTED.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS.description: NaveProtocol singleton on Ethereum mainnet (chain 1). REQUIRED before yield-sister cutover (Robinhood WETH to an Ethereum sister treasury), together with VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_FACTORY_ADDRESS. The checked-in contracts/evm/deployments/1.json is an Anvil fixture (daoStack undeployed) and cutover refuses to treat it as production. Fill these only from a real Safe-owned chain-1 deploy.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_FACTORY_ADDRESS.description: NaveDAOFactory singleton address on Ethereum mainnet (0x, 20 bytes).

VITE_EVM_BASE_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS.description: NaveProtocol singleton address on Base mainnet (0x, 20 bytes). From deployments/8453.json.

VITE_EVM_BASE_FACTORY_ADDRESS.description: NaveDAOFactory singleton address on Base mainnet (0x, 20 bytes).

VITE_EVM_PROTOCOL_REVENUE_WALLET.description: Nave-controlled EVM protocol revenue wallet used in DAO creation. REQUIRED when EVM is enabled on mainnet; founder fallback is refused by the app cutover.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_AAVE_ADAPTER_ADDRESS.description: Aave v3 strategy adapter deployed on Ethereum mainnet. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/adapters-1.json.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_COMPOUND_ADAPTER_ADDRE.description: Compound v3 strategy adapter deployed on Ethereum mainnet. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/adapters-1.json.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_BALANCER_ADAPTER_ADDRE.description: Balancer strategy adapter deployed on Ethereum mainnet. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/adapters-1.json.

VITE_EVM_BASE_AAVE_ADAPTER_ADDRESS.description: Aave v3 strategy adapter deployed on Base mainnet. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/adapters-8453.json.

VITE_EVM_BASE_COMPOUND_ADAPTER_ADDRESS.description: Compound v3 strategy adapter deployed on Base mainnet. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/adapters-8453.json.

VITE_EVM_BASE_BALANCER_ADAPTER_ADDRESS.description: Balancer strategy adapter on Base. adapters-8453.json records balancerAdapter as the zero address, balancer.status unset, balancer.offerInUi false. Do not deploy Balancer and do not set this until a pool id and minOut quote exist. A later UI pass must hide it.

VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_ARBITRUM_BRIDGE_ADAPT.description: Arbitrum Nitro bridge adapter on Robinhood (4663) for WETH outbound to Ethereum sister treasuries.

VITE_EVM_BASE_CCTP_BRIDGE_ADAPTER_ADDRES.description: CCTP USDC bridge adapter on Base mainnet.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_CCTP_BRIDGE_ADAPTER_AD.description: CCTP USDC bridge adapter on Ethereum mainnet.

VITE_EVM_BASE_OP_BRIDGE_ADAPTER_ADDRESS.description: OP StandardBridge adapter on Base for ETH/WETH hops to Ethereum.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_OP_BRIDGE_ADAPTER_ADDR.description: OP StandardBridge adapter on Ethereum for ETH/WETH hops to Base.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_RPC_URL.description: Browser/web RPC override for Ethereum mainnet (optional; falls back to viem public RPC).

VITE_EVM_BASE_RPC_URL.description: Browser/web RPC override for Base mainnet (optional).

VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL.description: Browser/web RPC override for Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663, Arbitrum Nitro L2; optional — falls back to the public https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com). MUST be a PUBLIC endpoint: this value ships in the browser bundle, so never put a keyed (e.g. Alchemy) URL here.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_WRAPPED_NAVE_ADDRESS.description: WrappedNave (wNAVE) token on Ethereum mainnet (1) for the app bridge/stake UI. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/hardened-bridge-1.json wrappedNave.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_BRIDGE_LOCKBOX_ADDRESS.description: NaveBridge lockbox on Ethereum mainnet (1) for the app bridge UI. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/hardened-bridge-1.json naveBridge and BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_1.

VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_STAKING_ADDRESS.description: NaveStaking drip pool on Ethereum mainnet (1) for the app stake UI. Must match BRIDGE_EVM_STAKING_1.

VITE_EVM_BASE_WRAPPED_NAVE_ADDRESS.description: WrappedNave (wNAVE) token on Base mainnet (8453) for the app bridge/stake UI. Must match contracts/evm/deployments/hardened-bridge-8453.json wrappedNave.

VITE_EVM_BASE_BRIDGE_LOCKBOX_ADDRESS.description: Preferred Base (8453) v2 UUPS lockbox (shared wNAVE). Minting follows on-chain wnave.minter(); keep VITE_EVM_BASE_BRIDGE_LOCKBOX_V1_ADDRESS until Safe rotates minter.

VITE_EVM_BASE_BRIDGE_LOCKBOX_V1_ADDRESS.description: Legacy immutable Base lockbox (still live). Mint fallback until wnave.minter() points at the v2 lockbox.

VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_BRIDGE_LOCKBOX_V1_ADD.description: Legacy immutable Robinhood lockbox (still live). Mint fallback until wnave.minter() points at the v2 lockbox.

VITE_EVM_BASE_STAKING_ADDRESS.description: NaveStaking drip pool on Base mainnet (8453) for the app stake UI. Must match BRIDGE_EVM_STAKING_8453.

VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_WRAPPED_NAVE_ADDRESS.description: WrappedNave (wNAVE) token on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663). Robinhood is BRIDGE/STAKE-ONLY (no DAO stack). Must match contracts/evm/deployments/hardened-bridge-4663.json wrappedNave.

VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_BRIDGE_LOCKBOX_ADDRES.description: NaveBridge lockbox on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663). Must match contracts/evm/deployments/hardened-bridge-4663.json naveBridge.

VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_STAKING_ADDRESS.description: NaveStaking drip pool on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663). Must match contracts/evm/deployments/hardened-bridge-4663.json naveStaking.

VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_RELAYER_URL.description: Public base URL of the signer-service bridge relayer the app calls (/bridge-relay, /stake-claim, /stake-claim/pool, /bridge-queue). The bridge/stake UI is disabled without it.

VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_PROGRAM_ID.description: nave_bridge Solana program id for the app (lock/burn built client-side). Must equal BRIDGE_SOLANA_BRIDGE_PROGRAM.

VITE_NAVE_STAKING_PROGRAM_ID.description: nave_staking Solana program id for the app stake UI. Must equal BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_PROGRAM.

VITE_SOLANA_NAVE_MINT.description: Canonical NAVE SPL mint the app bridges/stakes. Must equal BRIDGE_SOLANA_NAVE_MINT and MAINNET_NAVE_MINT.

VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_SOLANA_CUSTODY.description: Bridge custody token account (PDA-derived from the nave_bridge program) the app's Solana→EVM lock deposits into. Bridge UI is disabled without it.

VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_FEE_BPS.description: Total bridge fee in bps shown/charged by the app (default 250 = 2.5%). MUST equal BRIDGE_FEE_BPS and the on-chain BridgeConfig fee.

VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_STAKING_POOL_ACCOUNT.description: Staking fee-leg token account the app's Solana lock routes the 1% staking share to. With the mirror enabled this is the COLLECTOR — must equal BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_POOL_ACCOUNT.

VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_FEE_ACCOUNT.description: Protocol fee-leg token account the app's Solana lock routes the 1% protocol share to. Must equal BRIDGE_SOLANA_PROTOCOL_FEE_ACCOUNT.

VITE_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID.description: WalletConnect Cloud project id for RainbowKit connectors (optional).

EVM_ETHEREUM_RPC_URL.description: Server RPC for the EVM indexer + signer relayer on Ethereum. REQUIRED when Ethereum EVM is enabled.

EVM_BASE_RPC_URL.description: Server RPC for the EVM indexer + signer relayer on Base. REQUIRED when Base EVM is enabled.

EVM_ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL.description: Server RPC for the EVM indexer + signer relayer on Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663). REQUIRED when the Robinhood bridge triple is configured. Keyed (e.g. Alchemy) URLs are fine here — server-side only, never exposed to the browser.

EVM_LOG_CHUNK_BLOCKS.description: evm-indexer: max block span per eth_getLogs call. Free-tier RPCs cap this hard (e.g. Alchemy free = 10); paid mainnet endpoints usually allow 2000+. Too high → indexer errors, too low → slow backfill.

EVM_CONFIRMATIONS.description: evm-indexer: confirmation depth before an event is treated as indexable (reorg guard; independent of the relayer's BRIDGE_EVM_CONFIRMATIONS).

EVM_FINALITY_TAG.description: evm-indexer: optional finality tag ('finalized'/'safe') used instead of a fixed confirmation count where the chain supports it.

EVM_REORG_REWIND_BLOCKS.description: evm-indexer: how many blocks to rewind the cursor on restart to re-scan across possible reorgs.

ETHERSCAN_API_KEY.description: Etherscan API key for EVM contract verification on Ethereum (chain 1). REQUIRED by the EVM cutover when Ethereum is configured.

BASESCAN_API_KEY.description: Basescan API key for EVM contract verification on Base (chain 8453). REQUIRED by the EVM cutover when Base is configured.

NAVE_EVM_MASTER_KEK.description: Dedicated EVM master KEK (base64 32 bytes) wrapping secp256k1 agent/guardian DEKs in encrypted_evm_keys. Falls back to NAVE_MASTER_KEK when unset; the keygen edge fn and signer MUST use the same selection. REQUIRED (or NAVE_MASTER_KEK) when EVM is enabled.

NAVE_EVM_ABI_PATH.description: Optional path to the synced EVM contract event ABI JSON for the evm-indexer (overrides the built-in defaults).

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_TOKEN_ACCESS.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for token-gated access. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_GOVERNANCE_RATIFICATION.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for governance ratification flows. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_EXECUTION_REQUESTS.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for execution request creation. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_ASSET_REGISTRATION.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for asset registration. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_REVALUE_KEEPER.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for revalue keeper coverage before strategy execution. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_EMERGENCY_FREEZE.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for emergency freeze. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RELEASE_GATE_EXPLORER_LINKS.description: EVM mainnet release gate acknowledgement for Ethereum/Base explorer links. Must be "passed" when EVM is enabled.

EVM_RPC_URL.description: Fallback single-chain JSON-RPC for contracts EVM cutover (evm-mainnet-cutover.mjs). Prefer EVM_ETHEREUM_RPC_URL / EVM_BASE_RPC_URL / EVM_ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL — the cutover auto-selects from --chain-id and always verifies cast chain-id matches before deploy/handoff/verify.

EVM_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY.description: 0x-prefixed deploy/owner private key for the CONTRACTS EVM cutover deploy + handoff phases (this wallet is the initial PROTOCOL_OWNER pre-handoff). NEVER commit. Use EVM_DEPLOY_ACCOUNT (foundry keystore) instead where possible. One of EVM_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY or EVM_DEPLOY_ACCOUNT is required for deploy/handoff.

EVM_DEPLOY_ACCOUNT.description: Foundry keystore account name (cast wallet) used instead of EVM_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY for the CONTRACTS EVM cutover deploy + handoff phases. One of EVM_DEPLOY_PRIVATE_KEY or EVM_DEPLOY_ACCOUNT is required.

PROTOCOL_OWNER.description: Initial owner of NaveProtocol + PythOracle at deploy time (the deploy wallet, PRE-handoff). Ownership is transferred to SAFE_ADDRESS in the handoff phase. Constructor arg consumed by contracts/evm script/Deploy.s.sol.

PROTOCOL_TREASURY.description: Protocol fee recipient (native fee sink) bound into NaveProtocol at deploy. Constructor arg consumed by contracts/evm script/Deploy.s.sol.

PYTH_ADDRESS.description: Per-chain Pyth contract address passed to PythOracle at deploy. Set the value for the chosen --chain-id (Ethereum/Base mainnet or Sepolia/Base Sepolia). Constructor arg consumed by contracts/evm script/Deploy.s.sol.

SAFE_ADDRESS.description: Safe (Gnosis Safe) multisig that receives NaveProtocol (Ownable2Step, pending->accept) + PythOracle (Ownable, immediate) ownership in the handoff phase. The cutover verifies SAFE_ADDRESS has on-chain bytecode (cast code != 0x) BEFORE transferring, so authority is never sent to an EOA/empty address. The Safe must call acceptOwnership() on NaveProtocol to finalize.

FORMATION_FEE_WEI.description: Optional NaveProtocol DAO formation fee in wei. Must be 0. The EVM mainnet cutover refuses any non-zero value. Forming a treasury does not lock NAVE. Constructor arg for contracts/evm script/Deploy.s.sol.

TOKEN_MINT_FEE_WEI.description: NaveProtocol token-mint fee in wei. Required by the EVM mainnet cutover when EVM is enabled; canonical mainnet value is 50000000000000000 (0.05 ETH). Constructor arg for contracts/evm script/Deploy.s.sol.

TREASURY_SEED_WEI.description: EVM treasury-seed carve-out in wei (NaveProtocol.treasurySeed). Creation is now FEE-FREE so there is no fee to carve out: default 0 and the EVM mainnet cutover REFUSES any non-zero value. The founder supplies any initial treasury deposit separately. Constructor arg for contracts/evm script/Deploy.s.sol.

TOKEN_REVOKE_REWARD_WEI.description: Reserved EVM token-revoke reward value. Current Solidity contracts do not implement a revoke reward, so app mainnet cutover requires this to be unset or 0.

AAVE_V3_POOL.description: AaveV3Adapter constructor arg: the Aave v3 Pool address for the chosen --chain-id. Per-chain (Ethereum != Base). Consumed by the contracts adapter deploy (contracts/evm script/DeployAdapters.s.sol). Omit to skip the Aave adapter on this chain.

COMPOUND_V3_COMET.description: CompoundV3Adapter constructor arg: the Compound v3 Comet market address for the chosen --chain-id (single base asset per market). Per-chain. Omit to skip the Compound adapter on this chain.

BALANCER_VAULT.description: BalancerAdapter constructor arg: the Balancer v2 Vault address for the chosen --chain-id. Requires BALANCER_POOL_ID, BALANCER_BPT, BALANCER_ROUTED_ASSET, BALANCER_ASSET_INDEX, BALANCER_TOKEN_COUNT. Omit the whole set to skip the Balancer adapter on this chain.

BALANCER_POOL_ID.description: BalancerAdapter constructor arg: the 32-byte (0x, 64 hex) pool id for the routed Balancer pool on the chosen --chain-id.

BALANCER_BPT.description: BalancerAdapter constructor arg: the pool's BPT (LP) token address on the chosen --chain-id.

BALANCER_ROUTED_ASSET.description: BalancerAdapter constructor arg: the single asset the adapter routes (joins/exits) on the chosen --chain-id; must be one of the pool's registered tokens.

BALANCER_ASSET_INDEX.description: BalancerAdapter constructor arg: index of BALANCER_ROUTED_ASSET within the pool's registered token ordering (uint, 0-based).

BALANCER_TOKEN_COUNT.description: BalancerAdapter constructor arg: number of registered tokens in the pool (uint).

FAUCET_ENABLED.description: Devnet-only faucet toggle (gates both the NAVE `/faucet-claim` and SOL `/faucet-claim-sol` endpoints). MUST NOT be "true" on mainnet — enforced by assertBridgeFaucetMainnetSafety; the faucet gives away free NAVE and SOL and has no place in a mainnet deployment.

BRIDGE_RELAYER_ENABLED.description: Solana<->EVM NAVE bridge relayer toggle. Bridge is testnet-only today. Its original recipient-authentication gap on /bridge-relay was FIXED 2026-06-30 (P6-1 in docs/AUDIT_FINDINGS.md — caller must now sign a message with the same wallet that performed the source-chain lock/burn), but the fix has only been exercised on devnet/testnet, not battle-tested against real mainnet traffic or formally second-reviewed. If any BRIDGE_* var is set, NAVE_BRIDGE_MAINNET_REVIEWED must also be "true" (confirming that live battle-testing/second-review happened) or cutover refuses.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_RPC_URL.description: Bridge relayer's Solana RPC endpoint. See BRIDGE_RELAYER_ENABLED.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_NAVE_MINT.description: NAVE SPL mint the bridge locks/releases on Solana. See BRIDGE_RELAYER_ENABLED.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_BRIDGE_PROGRAM.description: nave_bridge program id. Custody + config + replay PDAs derive from it; the relayer builds `release` against it. When any bridge env is set, cutover refuses if this id is missing, is the closed mainnet id Fu3ZpX1SMvqVhuo7E4uKGvJxe6cJDFDxxmSCET6de9u6, or is not an executable program account. A future deploy needs a new program id. Do not put API keys in this value.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_RELAYER_AUTHORITY.description: Relayer keypair secret = the on-chain BridgeConfig.relayer that signs `release`. KMS/HSM-backed on mainnet (see docs/SECRETS.md). Falls back to BRIDGE_SOLANA_CUSTODY_AUTHORITY for continuity.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_CUSTODY_AUTHORITY.description: Legacy alias for BRIDGE_SOLANA_RELAYER_AUTHORITY (still honored). See BRIDGE_RELAYER_ENABLED.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_PROTOCOL_FEE_ACCOUNT.description: Protocol-revenue NAVE token account the release fee-split routes the 1% protocol leg to. Owned by BRIDGE_SOLANA_PROTOCOL_WALLET.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_POOL_ACCOUNT.description: NAVE token account the fee-split routes the 1% staking leg to. With the staking mirror enabled this MUST be the neutral relayer-owned COLLECTOR (BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_COLLECTOR — enforced at cutover), NOT the nave_staking reward vault; the mirror then splits collected fees across all chains by stake weight and each pool drips them over its rolling 365-day window.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_PROTOCOL_WALLET.description: Owner pubkey of the protocol-revenue account. Default 6N5JiWP2zF6VXhG6hwgYEYhxBEARAV5P6WRgfYb2zskC.

BRIDGE_EVM_MINTER_PRIVATE_KEY.description: EVM relayer EOA that calls the NaveBridge lockbox `bridgeIn`. KMS/HSM-backed on mainnet.

BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_11155111.description: NaveBridge lockbox address (Sepolia) — the sole wNAVE minter, capped/paused/replay-guarded.

BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_8453.description: Preferred Base v2 UUPS lockbox (shared wNAVE). Signer resolveMintLockbox() follows on-chain minter.

BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_46630.description: NaveBridge lockbox address (Robinhood Chain testnet 46630, Arbitrum Nitro L2).

BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_4663.description: Preferred Robinhood v2 UUPS lockbox (shared wNAVE).

BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_V1_8453.description: Legacy Base lockbox — mint fallback until Safe setMinter(v2) + acceptMinterRole.

BRIDGE_EVM_LOCKBOX_V1_4663.description: Legacy Robinhood lockbox — mint fallback until Safe setMinter(v2) + acceptMinterRole.

BRIDGE_EVM_CONFIRMATIONS.description: OPTIONAL global FLOOR for EVM confirmation depth. Semantics changed: it can only deepen, never shallow, a chain default. Authoritative depth is per chain: BRIDGE_EVM_CONFIRMATIONS_<chainId> (defaults 1: 12, 8453: 30, 4663: 60). Cutover refuses any configured chain below its default.

BRIDGE_EVM_CONFIRMATIONS_1.description: Ethereum mainnet confirmation depth before releasing NAVE on Solana (default 12, ~2.4 min). Must be >= 12.

BRIDGE_EVM_CONFIRMATIONS_8453.description: Base confirmation depth (default 30 blocks ≈ 60 s). Must be >= 30.

BRIDGE_EVM_CONFIRMATIONS_4663.description: Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum Nitro, ~0.25 s blocks) confirmation depth (default 60). Soft sequencer confirmation precedes hard L1 finality — never lower than 60.

BRIDGE_EVM_CHAIN_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated allow-list of EVM chain ids the relayer serves (default: every known chain on NAVE_EVM_NETWORK). Mainnet: subset of 1,8453,4663.

BRIDGE_LOOKBACK_SECONDS.description: Missed-event scan window for the bridge watcher, converted to blocks per chain from block time (default 7200; cutover requires >= 3600). Replaces BRIDGE_WATCHER_EVM_LOOKBACK_BLOCKS, which is now only a floor in blocks.

NAVE_EVM_NETWORK.description: Relayer/signer EVM network selector: mainnet | testnet. Sole resolver for family-name routes ('base'|'robinhood'|'ethereum') — the Solana cluster is no longer consulted. MUST be "mainnet" on the mainnet path; REQUIRED whenever EVM or the bridge is enabled.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.description: Reverse-proxy hops the signer trusts for X-Forwarded-For (Express `trust proxy`). Railway = 1 (default). 0 disables proxy trust. Rate-limit identity is derived from req.ip, never the leftmost XFF entry.

EVM_ETHEREUM_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS.description: Edge-function mirror of VITE_EVM_ETHEREUM_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS (auto-derived by the cutover). generate-evm-agent-keys bind verifies treasury.protocol() equals it.

EVM_ROBINHOOD_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS.description: Edge-function mirror of VITE_EVM_ROBINHOOD_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS (auto-derived) — required when Robinhood hosts a DAO stack (--scope full).

LLM_TIMEOUT_MS.description: agent-dispatcher: AbortSignal timeout for each model call (default 60000).

LLM_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET.description: agent-dispatcher: per-DAO daily token ceiling across all agent roles (default 2000000; 0 disables). Exceeding returns 429 llm_budget_exceeded.

NAVE_EXECUTION_GRACE_SECS.description: agent-orchestrator: how long a post-review request may stay parked (request_review / non-terminal) before it is expired (default 86400).

NAVE_BREAK_GLASS_SECRET.description: Operator-only secret required (header X-Break-Glass-Secret) for generate-agent-keys break_glass raw-DEK export. Leave UNSET on mainnet unless an incident runbook needs it; unset = mode disabled.

NAVE_ORACLE_PERSIST_TTL_SECONDS.description: nave-price-oracle: anonymous GETs persist a price row at most once per this many seconds (default 60); X-Indexer-Secret callers always persist.

BRIDGE_FEE_BPS.description: Total bridge fee in bps charged on top (default 250 = 2.5%). Must match VITE_NAVE_BRIDGE_FEE_BPS.

STAKING_MIRROR_ENABLED.description: Staking global-parity mirror toggle (signer-service worker tick). Splits the bridge's 1% staking-fee collector across the Solana nave_staking pool and each EVM NaveStaking by live stake weight; every pool drips its share over a rolling 365-day window (realized APY converges globally). Requires BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_COLLECTOR + BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_PROGRAM and BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_POOL_ACCOUNT repointed at the collector; covered by the NAVE_BRIDGE_MAINNET_REVIEWED gate.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_COLLECTOR.description: Neutral relayer-owned NAVE token account that accumulates the bridge's 1% staking leg for the mirror to distribute. On-chain BridgeConfig.staking_pool_owner must be this account's owner (the relayer wallet) — set via nave_bridge set_config at cutover.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_STAKING_PROGRAM.description: nave_staking program id (stake-pool / reward-vault PDAs derive from it). The mirror reads StakePool.total_staked and sends the collector's Solana share + `sync` against it.

BRIDGE_EVM_STAKING_11155111.description: NaveStaking drip pool address (Sepolia). The relayer EOA (BRIDGE_EVM_MINTER_PRIVATE_KEY) must be the on-chain `rewarder`.

BRIDGE_EVM_STAKING_46630.description: NaveStaking drip pool address (Robinhood Chain testnet 46630).

BRIDGE_EVM_STAKING_4663.description: NaveStaking drip pool address (Robinhood Chain mainnet 4663).

STAKING_MIRROR_MIN_RAW.description: Minimum collector balance (NAVE base units, 6 decimals) before the mirror distributes; below it the tick only sends a permissionless `sync` poke. Default 1000000 (1 NAVE).

STAKING_MIRROR_SRC_CHAIN_ID.description: Lockbox srcChainId reserved for staking-mirror wNAVE mints (replay-key partition). MUST differ from BRIDGE_SOLANA_SRC_CHAIN_ID (bridge mints, 900). Default 901.

STAKING_MIRROR_INTERVAL_MS.description: Staking-mirror worker tick cadence in milliseconds. Default 600000 (10m).

STAKE_CLAIM_ENABLED.description: EVM claim-on-demand rewards toggle (signer-service). EVM stakers accrue a pro-rata share of the ONE Solana reward pool in the Supabase evm_reward_accounts ledger; the relayer wraps + mints wNAVE straight to the staker at claim time (/stake-claim). When enabled, the staking mirror parks EVM fee shares in STAKE_CLAIM_RESERVE instead of pre-funding per-chain NaveStaking drip contracts.

STAKE_CLAIM_RESERVE.description: Relayer-owned Solana NAVE token account backing EVM claim-on-demand payouts. The mirror moves each tick's combined EVM fee share here; /stake-claim draws reserve → bridge custody before minting wNAVE, keeping wNAVE fully backed. Required when STAKE_CLAIM_ENABLED=true.

STAKE_CLAIM_SRC_CHAIN_ID.description: Lockbox srcChainId partition for claim-on-demand reward mints. MUST differ from BRIDGE_SOLANA_SRC_CHAIN_ID (bridge, 900) and STAKING_MIRROR_SRC_CHAIN_ID (mirror, 901). Default 902.

STAKE_CLAIM_MAX_RAW.description: Optional per-claim payout cap in NAVE base units (6 decimals). Unset/0 = uncapped; the reserve balance always caps payouts regardless.

STAKE_CLAIM_MIN_RAW.description: Optional minimum claimable (NAVE base units, 6 decimals) before /stake-claim executes; sub-minimum claims are rejected with an explanation. Every payout costs the relayer a Solana wrap fee + EVM mint gas (meaningful on Ethereum mainnet), so a floor (e.g. 1000000 = 1 NAVE) blocks dust-claim griefing. Unset/0 = no floor.

BRIDGE_SOLANA_RELAYER_PUBKEY.description: Optional: the PUBLIC key of the Solana bridge relayer hot wallet (audit P1). When set, the mainnet cutover asserts it differs from SQUADS_VAULT (the multisig owner). The authoritative owner!=relayer check runs on-chain in the contracts cutover verify phase.

BRIDGE_EVM_RELAYER_ADDRESS.description: Optional: the PUBLIC address of the EVM bridge relayer/rewarder EOA (audit P1). When set, the mainnet cutover asserts it differs from SAFE_ADDRESS (the multisig owner). The authoritative owner!=relayer/rewarder check runs on-chain in the contracts cutover verify phase.

BRIDGE_WATCHER_ENABLED.description: Independent bridge watcher toggle (signer-service worker tick, audit M-1). Retries stale/failed bridge_transfers through the verified relay path (bounded by retry_count, then parked as 'stuck') and optionally scans chains for missed BridgeLock/BridgeBurnTo events. Reuses the BRIDGE_* relayer config; on-chain replay guards remain the double-spend protection.

BRIDGE_WATCHER_STALE_MS.description: How long a transfer must be idle before the watcher retry sweep touches it (ms). Default 600000 (10m).

BRIDGE_WATCHER_MAX_RETRIES.description: Max automatic re-executions before a transfer is parked as status 'stuck'. Default 5.

BRIDGE_WATCHER_BATCH_SIZE.description: Transfers considered per watcher sweep. Default 25.

BRIDGE_WATCHER_SCAN_EVENTS.description: Enable the missed-event chain scan in addition to the retry sweep.

BRIDGE_WATCHER_INTERVAL_MS.description: Watcher worker tick cadence in milliseconds. Default 300000 (5m).

NAVE_BRIDGE_MAINNET_REVIEWED.description: Explicit override confirming the mainnet-hardened bridge review is complete (supplyCap + mintPaused set, multisig owners, KMS relayer keys, caps configured). Required ("true") if any BRIDGE_* var is set during a mainnet cutover; otherwise cutover refuses.
